notes: ὀλιγοπιστίαν heads on 'faith', the compound's core, not on the incorporated ὀλιγο- (rule 66).
The article before ὄρει is emptied by the demonstrative τούτῳ (rule 38), so nothing anchors the case preposition and 'unto' rides with the noun discontinuously (rules 15, 21).
σινάπεως heads on 'mustard' and ἐκεῖ on 'yonder', the supplied 'seed' and 'place' being generic completions (rules 17, 66).
ἐάν here is an ordinary conditional aligned to 'If'; rule 72's generalizing arm does not reach it.
